what_it_does: Ironwood is a processor accelerator designed specifically for reasoning models—a new class of AI models (like OpenAI's o1 and DeepSeek-R1) that spend significant compute time ``thinking'' through long chains of logic before producing an answer. Ironwood optimizes for both training these models and running them in production, focusing on three key metrics: raw speed, cost per unit of computation (TCO—total cost of ownership), and power efficiency (performance-per-watt). The challenge is that reasoning workloads differ sharply from typical language models—they require enormous amounts of intermediate data to track thoughts across steps.
